note: Two primitive camping spots. One is at the area entrance on County Road 630: a gravel lot at the edge of an old field, with no view of the lake. The other is at the lake, about a quarter mile down the area's gravel road: a small mown plot with young trees and a fire ring, set off by boulders from the corner of the boat-ramp lot, so a rig stays on the gravel lot beside it, a few yards from the water with the lake open in front. Privy, fishing jetty and concrete ramp at the lake. The approach is several miles of gravel county road. No pads, tables or water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - two Primitive Camping symbols on the map (entrance lot, and beside the boat ramp) and two GIS camping points. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; the brochure says camping is allowed anytime in designated areas. Phone matches the area page. Pin is on the entrance spot; the lake spot is the one with something to see - pin and lakeview leads flagged.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; the brochure says 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas. These may or may not have defined campsites. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply.' The map (4/18/2019) draws a Primitive Camping symbol beside the Parking Lot at the entrance and another beside the Concrete Boat Ramp symbol on the lake's north shore; GIS layer 27 has both ('Primitive Camping Area', OBJECTIDs 408 and 560). Both are designated points at lots.

WHAT EACH SPOT SEES OF THE LAKE: (1) entrance spot, GIS 408 at 38.08876,-92.15203 (the stored pin): the point is at the edge of an old field beside a gravel lot about 25 x 15 m where the area road leaves County Road 630. The lake is about 350 m south beyond a timbered ridge - nothing of it is seen. (2) lake spot, GIS 560 at 38.08580,-92.14998: on the 100 m leaf-off frame a mown plot about 25 x 15 m with a dozen small planted trees and one fire ring, closed off from the north-east corner of the boat-ramp lot by a line of boulders, about 20-25 m from the water's edge with open mown ground and a foot track to the dam between. Vehicles cannot enter the plot, so a motorhome stands on the ramp lot (gravel, about 45 x 15 m, GIS lot 366 at 38.08548,-92.15067), whose south edge is riprap about 5-10 m from the water, the concrete ramp at its south-east corner. The lake (brochure: 29 acres; area page Quick Facts not read for the figure) is fully open from the lot and the plot.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored not waterfront, true of the stored entrance pin; I did not change it): if the pin moves to the lake spot, the rig's place is the boat-ramp lot - a ramp and day-use lot - so by the 2026-11-01 rulings it is lakeview at best, not lakefront. The view itself is unobstructed.

PIN: stored 38.08876,-92.15203 = GIS point 408, the entrance spot, 20 m from its lot (GIS lot 365). Neither spot is a built camp. The lake spot is where the privy, ramp and jetty are; if the pin should sit there, use the ramp lot's north-east corner beside the plot, 38.08565,-92.15030 (about 375 m south-east of the stored pin, same road, no split).

ACCESS: 'From Vienna, take Highway 42 west, then Highway 133 south to Route DD, then west to County Road 631, then south to County Road 630, then east to area entrance.' The brochure adds 'The entrance of the area is 1/4 mile south of the west end of county road DD.' The map shows the road from the entrance to the lake as 'MDC Improved Road'; on imagery it is a graded gravel road about 6 m wide. No low-water crossing, 4WD wording or posted limit on the page, brochure or map. OSM was unread (the Overpass mirror timed out), so the county roads' surfaces are not confirmed beyond what imagery shows at the entrance (gravel).
PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 matches the area page's 'For more information call (573) 815-7900'.
LAKE SIZE: the brief says 27 acres; the area page and the brochure both say 29 acres.
SEASON: stored year_round (manual) agrees with the brochure ('allowed anytime').
